summary: This line tells the web server to permanently redirect any requests for /old.php to a new location at http://www.yoursite.com/new.php. The 301 status code signals to browsers and search engines that this is a permanent move, so they'll update their records accordingly.

explanations.1: Redirect 301 means 'send a permanent redirect response' — the 301 is the HTTP status code that tells clients this resource has moved for good. /old.php is the old path the user might request, and the long URL is where they should actually go instead.
